bundle.shortDescription: 3D modeler with SketchUp's interaction model on a solids-first kernel
bundle.longDescription: Hew is a cross-platform 3D modeler: draw on faces, push and pull them, and let inference snapping do the aiming. Every closed extrusion is a discrete, watertight object, and combining objects is always an explicit choice.
